run_cal_train_time: run the cal_train_time function to analyze average training iteration time from JSON logs
run_plot_curve: run the plot_curve function to plot training metrics like bbox_mAP from JSON logs
run_load_json_logs: run the load_json_logs function to parse JSON log files into epoch-based dictionaries
run_parse_args: run the parse_args function to parse CLI arguments for plot_curve or cal_train_time tasks
run_main: run the main function to analyze JSON training logs via CLI with plot_curve or cal_train_time subcommands
